Programme UKVI Sponsored Student Compliance Policy Home › International students › Summer abroad opportunities Summer Abroad opportunities Six exciting opportunities to spend your summer abroad completing a four-week programme at a partner institution. In 2025, students will have the opportunity to select one of six programmes taking place in either Malaysia, India, France, Czechia or Brazil. Why should you take part in a Summer Abroad programme: Develop your employability skills including team work, communication and intercultural awareness Learn new academic skills Become a global citizen Make new friends Have fun! Destinations Malaysian Culture Summer School in Kuala Lumpur Health Summer School in Malaysia Doing Business in Brazil Art & Design Programme in India French Language and Culture in France Eligibility Our Summer Abroad programmes and funding are available to current students including final year students enrolled on a Bachelor. Master’s or PhD programme on Middlesbrough or Darlington Campus. Students from the London campus should contact TUGlobal before applying to the programmes. Online students and students studying for a short course are not eligible. Fees and Scholarships Each programme has its own fees, please check each destination for more information. Fees include transportation, airport transfer, academic programme, accommodation, cultural activities, and other activities related to the programme (unless otherwise specified). Personal expenses, visa, and extra costs such as vaccination are not included. Students from Disadvantaged Background Students from a disadvantaged Background and meeting at least one of the criteria by the Turing Scheme will be offered the Disadvantaged Background Fee: Students with low household income or low socio-economic status (including those with an annual household income of £25,000 or less – on Student Finance England) UK/Home students only Students receiving Universal Credit or income-related benefits because they are financially supporting themselves or financially supporting themselves and someone who is dependent on them and living with them, such as a child or partner – UK/Home students only Students who are Care Leavers – UK/Home students only Students who have unpaid caring responsibilities – UK/Home students only First Generation Students - UK/Home students only Students from POLAR 1 and 2 , and TUNDRA 1 and 2 – Based on applicant postcodes (address before student joined Teesside University and used for your application to your course) - UK/Home students only - You can check if you would qualify here https://www.officeforstudents.org.uk/data-and-analysis/young-participation-by-area/search-by-postcode/ Drop-in sessions Join an online drop-in session to speak with the TU Global team. Available online every Wednesday 1pm-4pm throughout February and March 2025. Join now Got a question, and not available for the Wednesday online drop-in? Contact us to book a 1-2-1 appointment at TUGlobal@tees.ac.uk How to apply Applications will be reviewed and graded based on your replies to the 'Personal Statement' section. You can apply for more than one destination. You can prepare your personal statement in advance. Personal statement questions include: Why do you wish to take part in the Summer Abroad programme? How do you think this experience will develop you professionally and personally? Why do you think you would be a good Teesside University ambassador while abroad? Application deadline: Sunday 16 March 2025 5.00pm (UK Time) Pre-selected applicants will be invited for an interview to discuss their application by the end of March. Details of the interviews will be sent to the pre-selected students. Successful applicants will be contacted after the interviews. Apply directly via the link on the destination page. Successful applicants will be required to pay a £100 deposit to confirm their place. Contact us at TUGlobal@tees.ac.uk for alternative application formats Programme search Search courses starting September and January Your country Get information specific to your country. Policy Home › International students › Partnerships Partnerships Our Global Partnerships connect us with leading educational institutions across Europe, the Middle East, Central Asia, East Asia, Southeast Asia, and South Asia. By collaborating with renowned universities and specialised schools, we provide our students with access to diverse learning experiences and international perspectives. These partnerships allow us to offer industry-relevant courses in fields ranging from business and management to fashion design, digital innovation, health and life sciences, and media production. Through this global network, we aim to foster cross-cultural collaboration and prepare students for success in an interconnected world. Work with us For more information on working with us, please email TUGlobalPartnerships@tees.ac.uk Central Asia Uzbekistan MDIS - Tashkent The Management Development Institute of Singapore (MDIS) in Tashkent is a top business and management school, known for its high-quality education and international partnerships. Find out more Tajikistan MDIS - Dushanbe MDIS Dushanbe offers a range of business and management courses, with a strong focus on practical application and globally recognized degrees in collaboration with international universities. Find out more Europe Italy Plena Education - Ferrari Fashion School - Scuola Politecnica Design Ferrari Fashion School, part of Plena Education, is renowned for its specialized training in fashion design and technology. Students receive hands-on experience, preparing them for careers in the global fashion industry. It fosters creativity and innovation through practical and collaborative learning environments. Find out more Spain Centro de Estudios del Video A leading institution in Spain specializing in video production and media education, it emphasizes the development of technical skills and creative storytelling. Find out more Sweden Hyper Island - Stockholm A digital creative business school offering immersive learning experiences, Hyper Island focuses on digital strategy, innovation, and leadership for the modern workplace. Find out more South Asia Sri Lanka Business Management School (BMS) BMS in Sri Lanka offers a variety of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in partnership with international universities, focusing on equipping students with business and management skills. Find out more Nepal IEC College of Art & Fashion Established in 1997, IEC provides practical training in fashion and interior design, giving students hands-on experience, exposure to global trends and the latest technology, and preparing them to become future industry leaders. Find out more Southeast Asia Malaysia Universiti Teknologi Mara (UiTM) Malaysia's largest public university, UiTM offers a wide range of courses and is known for fostering entrepreneurship and innovation among its students. Teesside University delivers a selection of health courses at UiTM , designed to enhance professional skills and support career progression in the healthcare sector. It collaborates with global universities to provide industry-relevant education. Find out more Singapore Amity Global Institute Amity Global Institute offers programs in business management and technology in partnership with leading global universities, emphasizing global exposure and career-oriented education. Find out more Singapore Hyper Island - Singapore Hyper Island Singapore provides courses focused on digital transformation and leadership, helping students and professionals adapt to the rapidly changing digital landscape. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Prior to joining the university, she worked at York St John University and University Bordeaux Montaigne (France). Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. His experience also includes work on the UK government's Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office committee for international scholarships. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Prior to joining the university, she worked at York St John University and University Bordeaux Montaigne (France). Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. Matthew Gallagher International Conversion Manager matthew.gallagher@tees.ac.uk Matthew joined the DID in May 2023 with over 10 years' experience working in the higher education sector. During his career, he has specialised in international recruitment and partnership development in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and the Americas. His experience also includes work on the UK government's Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office committee for international scholarships. In his current role, he develops integrated communication plans to guide students through the admissions and compliance process. In addition to this, his role also helps to advise students on how make an application, as well as advising students on pre-departure and orientation details. Matthew's portfolio also includes international scholarships and the extremely popular TU webinars for international students and partners. Lindsey specialises in visual communication, focusing on widening audience participation through Accessibility best practices. Her previous roles involved working with students, businesses and stakeholders, skills she still continues to use in her current role. As Administrator she is responsible for monitoring the department budgets, arranging travel and supporting the Centre Manager with Erasmus+. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Prior to joining the university, she worked at York St John University and University Bordeaux Montaigne (France). Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. Matthew Gallagher International Conversion Manager matthew.gallagher@tees.ac.uk Matthew joined the DID in May 2023 with over 10 years' experience working in the higher education sector. During his career, he has specialised in international recruitment and partnership development in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and the Americas. His experience also includes work on the UK government's Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office committee for international scholarships. In his current role, he develops integrated communication plans to guide students through the admissions and compliance process. In addition to this, his role also helps to advise students on how make an application, as well as advising students on pre-departure and orientation details. Matthew's portfolio also includes international scholarships and the extremely popular TU webinars for international students and partners. Lindsey Paylor-Orr International Marketing Officer l.paylor-orr@tees.ac.uk Lindsey joined Teesside University in 2015 following several years in marketing and communication roles at the University of the Arts, London. She is responsible for developing innovative digital and print marketing assets to support international development activities. Lindsey specialises in visual communication, focusing on widening audience participation through Accessibility best practices. Angela Faulkner Administration Coordinator a.faulkner@tees.ac.uk Angela has been with the university for over eleven years, the last six in International Development. Her previous roles involved working with students, businesses and stakeholders, skills she still continues to use in her current role. As Administrator she is responsible for monitoring the department budgets, arranging travel and supporting the Centre Manager with Erasmus+. Jade Davies International Marketing Assistant j.davies@tees.ac.uk Jade started her journey at Teesside University in June 2022, bringing a broad wealth of expertise in marketing and communications. Back during her pursuit of a bachelor's degree, a remarkable achievement came her way - the Dolphin Brewin Scholarship for International Business, beckoning her to Amsterdam for studies. This unique opportunity not only enriched her academic pursuits but also bestowed upon her a profound understanding of the global student adventure. In her capacity as an International Marketing Assistant, Jade plays a pivotal role, collaborating with the dynamic international marketing team to orchestrate and propel the University's endeavours in global marketing and communication. She has also achieved a Distinction in MSc Digital Marketing. Louise Kirby International Development Administrator l.kirby@tees.ac.uk With over 20 years' experience in Administration and PA roles across Teesside, Louise joined Teesside University in September 2013. She has previously worked as a PA in the School of Design, Culture and the Arts and the School of Science, Engineering and Design. Since February 2019, Louise has delivered the role of PA to the Director for International Development. Ijeoma Mbajunwa West Africa Country Manager africa@tees.ac.uk Ijeoma joined Teesside University's West Africa Regional Office in 2019. She has provided administrative support for international students from across West Africa who intend to study at Teesside University, since 2014. In addition, she is responsible for organising the Teesside English Language Test for applicants from Africa. Shukurah Abolanle Assistant Manager, Admissions & Compliance S.Olajide@tees.ac.uk Shukurah Abolanle joined Teesside University West Africa Regional Office as Assistant Manager Admissions & Compliance in November 2021 where she is responsible for admissions and compliance issues within the region and provides support to international students on their application. Esther Sobola Student Recruitment and Conversion Officer e.olugbenga@tees.ac.uk Esther joined the West Africa Regional Office of Teesside University in September 2022 as a Student Recruitment and Conversion Officer. In her role, she is responsible for providing comprehensive support to international students throughout their admission journey, Esther's commitment to delivering exceptional service has helped numerous students transition smoothly into their academic pursuits at Teesside University. HOU Liang China Regional Director hou.liang@tees.ac.uk Liang joined Teesside University's International team in 2007 and leads the China office for the University. Liang originally came as an international student in 1999 from Shandong Province in China; he enjoys much of the local culture and made lots of friends locally. The North East of England became his new home. Liang stayed in this region for 12 years before moving back to Beijing to set up the China office. Having been a student himself, he understands international students and is always willing to help them. Benefitting from his own experience in the UK, he is eager to share it with the international students. WANG Mengsi Office Manager m.wang@tees.ac.uk Mengsi has been working for Teesside University China office since March 2012. She has worked in a variety of roles including admissions, marketing and recruitment in China. Her current role as Manager of the China office includes responsibility for Business School recruitment and managing the team. Mengsi enjoys traveling across China, interacting with students and providing the most up to date information about Teesside University. SUN Pingyao Recruitment Manager p.sun@tees.ac.uk Pingyao joined Teesside University China Office in April 2015 after graduating from the University of the West Scotland (BA) and Cardiff University (PG). Initially responsible for admissions, in September 2016 Pingyao started to work as Recruitment Officer for Creative programmes and managed the agent network, international foundation programmes, public universities, articulation programmes and individual applicants. Pingyao truly enjoys traveling all over China and expanding her knowledge when traveling with academics from different Schools. It is an exciting opportunity for her to share her knowledge and experience of our university with students and partners. FENG Xueer Admission Officer X.Feng@tees.ac.uk With over 6 years of experience in international education, Xueer joined Teesside University China Office in September 2024 as an Admissions Officer. She is responsible for admissions and enquiries from students and agents. Xueer is dedicated to enhancing the University's impact in China and helping students begin their journey at Teesside University. ZHOU Jiaqi Marketing Officer j.zhou@tees.ac.uk Jiaqi accomplished her master program in Southampton in 2014. Her previous working experience at a German education consulting company has brought her great interest in education and marketing. Jiaqi joined Teesside University as the Marketing Officer within the China Office in early 2017 and is responsible for marketing activities in China. She aims to enhance the branding of Teesside University in China. TANG Tianyu Tianyu.Tang@tees.ac.uk Tianyu has accomplished his master's programme in Indiana University of Pennsylvania in 2015 and joined Teesside University China Office in early 2019. He is responsible for the agent network and Health programmes. He enjoys local food during travel and like extreme sports. ZHAI Jiayue J.Zhai@tees.ac.uk Jiayue graduated from the University of Southampton with Marketing Management and joined in China office in July 2019. She is mainly responsible for Admissions and assists colleagues by responding to enquiries from student or agents as well. In her spare time, she enjoys travelling for enriching the knowledge and experiencing various cultures. GAO Ziyu Recruitment Officer Ziyu.Gao@tees.ac.uk Ziyu joined the China team in October 2024. He is responsible for the development of partnerships with institutions in China and increasing Teesside brand awareness. He is dedicated to improving student recruitment and fostering the Alumni network. Based in South China, he is passionate about supporting all our incoming students through the entire cycle, from application to orientation. His experience also includes work in the global tech industry and international education institutions. Reach out with questions about the Teesside Experience. Syed Abidi Regional Director - Pakistan S.Abidi@tees.ac.uk Syed Abidi is a renowned Educationist, Consultant and Trainer with over 25 years' experience in international education, marketing and recruitment. His responsibilities include expanding the current Pakistan market, overseeing the agent network, training and assuring outstanding support is delivered to students and partners of Teesside University. In addition, Syed identifies development opportunities within the Middle Eastern Region including but not limited to KSA, UAE, Oman, Iran and Bahrain. Syed Abidi is a recipient of a most prestigious Civil Award in Education from the President of Pakistan and has several international commendations and awards in the area of international student recruitment. Khalida Parveen Business development & operations officer k.parveen@tees.ac.uk Khalida has joined Teesside Regional Office Pakistan as Business Development and Operations Officer. She has more than 8 years of experience in international student recruitment and marketing with different reputable agencies. She will be assisting the Pakistan office in enhancing TU branding and profile and provide support in day to day operations. Zaeem Masood Regional Support Officer - Pakistan z.masood@tees.ac.uk Zaeem joined Teesside University in June 2021. He has 15 years of experience in student recruitment. He is responsible for admissions, marketing and recruitment activities in the Pakistan and Middle East/North Africa (MENA) region, including developing and maintaining working relationships with agencies. Padmini Parameswaran South Asia Regional Director padmini.parameswaran@tees.ac.uk Padmini joined Teesside University in the year 2016. She has 20 years of experience with Education UK. She started her professional career as a teacher and after working with some of the best schools across the country she joined Middlesex University's Regional Office as Manager of Admissions. She was Regional Director at University of Central Lancashire, University of East London and Northumbria University before she joined Teesside University. Padmini enjoys interacting with students and advising them on their career choices. She also likes to travel across South Asia and meet students from diverse backgrounds and cultures. Despite her experience, the role is a constant learning curve, even after several years of experience. Jayanti Pathare Conversions Manager J.Pathare@tees.ac.uk Jayanti joined Teesside University's South Asia office in December 2021 as an Assistant Manager and is currently working as the Conversions Manager; responsible for recruitment, conversions, and pre-departure activities among other things. She has almost a decade's worth of experience with Immigration New Zealand, having worked at their Auckland and Mumbai offices, where her last role was as a Technical Advisor. Iona Furtado Compliance Manager - South Asia i.furtado@tees.ac.uk Iona joined Teesside University as a Compliance Manager (South Asia) in 2021. She has 17 years of experience, a better part of which was as a Senior Immigration Officer at Immigration New Zealand. She also previously worked in operations at JP Morgan Chase. Padvala Nandan Naidu Compliance Manager - South Asia p.naidu@tees.ac.uk Nandan joined Teesside University as a Compliance Manager (South Asia) in 2021. His work involves conducting credibility interviews, verifying maintenance documents, overseeing enrollments and looking after compliance issues for South Asia applicants. He has over 10 years of experience in student recruitment for the universities in the UK and Ireland. He previously worked at Nexus Educational Services and IDP Education. He was awarded Top Counsellor for IDP - Pan India in 2019 and 2020 and has delivered more than 50 seminars about studying in the UK. June Chai South East Asia Regional Director, SEA regional office j.chai@tees.ac.uk June joined Teesside University South East Asia regional office in early 2019. Prior to Teesside University, she was also in recruitment of students for Malaysia, the UK and USA institutions for the past 15 years. Her current role includes developing and executing strategic business plans, positioning of Teesside University in SEA, building a strong network of local partners, recruitment of students with her team in the regional office; just to name a few. June enjoys the thrill in recruitment and the opportunities to meet with people from different walks of life. Her greatest satisfaction come from her students' success and building lifelong friendship along the way. June looks forward to grow, to learn and to succeed together with Teesside University in this region. Rachel Lee Operations Manager, SEA regional office rachel.lee@tees.ac.uk Rachel graduated from Lancaster University in 2019 with a MBA Master of Business Administration. She joined Teesside University's South East Asia regional office in 2007 when the office started its operations. She was previously was the Head of Operations and Finance for SEGi College in Penang, Malaysia. As an Operations Manager, Rachel manages the admission processes for South East Asia, and is also responsible for general operations, finance, office budgets and collaborations with transnational education (TNE) partners. Rachel plays a key role in organising and managing Teesside University's events in the South East Asia region. Ronnie Chai Regional Manager, ASEAN r.chai@tees.ac.uk Ronnie joined Teesside University as Assistant Regional Manager to support the execution of regional recruitment, marketing strategy, market research, marketing campaigns and marketing communications. He also supports the development and management of partnerships in conjunction with the international partnerships team and supports other initiatives aimed at raising the profile of Teesside University in these markets. Prior to working with Teesside University, Ronnie developed significant experience of assisting Southeast Asia students in the pursuit of higher education opportunities. In addition, he was also in student recruitment with a premier education group in Singapore. Ronnie enjoys the process of recruitment as much as the outcome and successes of his work. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Prior to joining the university, she worked at York St John University and University Bordeaux Montaigne (France). Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. Matthew Gallagher International Conversion Manager matthew.gallagher@tees.ac.uk Matthew joined the DID in May 2023 with over 10 years' experience working in the higher education sector. During his career, he has specialised in international recruitment and partnership development in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and the Americas. His experience also includes work on the UK government's Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office committee for international scholarships. In his current role, he develops integrated communication plans to guide students through the admissions and compliance process. In addition to this, his role also helps to advise students on how make an application, as well as advising students on pre-departure and orientation details. Matthew's portfolio also includes international scholarships and the extremely popular TU webinars for international students and partners. Lindsey Paylor-Orr International Marketing Officer l.paylor-orr@tees.ac.uk Lindsey joined Teesside University in 2015 following several years in marketing and communication roles at the University of the Arts, London. She is responsible for developing innovative digital and print marketing assets to support international development activities. Lindsey specialises in visual communication, focusing on widening audience participation through Accessibility best practices. Angela Faulkner Administration Coordinator a.faulkner@tees.ac.uk Angela has been with the university for over eleven years, the last six in International Development. Her previous roles involved working with students, businesses and stakeholders, skills she still continues to use in her current role. As Administrator she is responsible for monitoring the department budgets, arranging travel and supporting the Centre Manager with Erasmus+. Jade Davies International Marketing Assistant j.davies@tees.ac.uk Jade started her journey at Teesside University in June 2022, bringing a broad wealth of expertise in marketing and communications. Back during her pursuit of a bachelor's degree, a remarkable achievement came her way - the Dolphin Brewin Scholarship for International Business, beckoning her to Amsterdam for studies. This unique opportunity not only enriched her academic pursuits but also bestowed upon her a profound understanding of the global student adventure. In her capacity as an International Marketing Assistant, Jade plays a pivotal role, collaborating with the dynamic international marketing team to orchestrate and propel the University's endeavours in global marketing and communication. She has also achieved a Distinction in MSc Digital Marketing. Louise Kirby International Development Administrator l.kirby@tees.ac.uk With over 20 years' experience in Administration and PA roles across Teesside, Louise joined Teesside University in September 2013. She has previously worked as a PA in the School of Design, Culture and the Arts and the School of Science, Engineering and Design. Since February 2019, Louise has delivered the role of PA to the Director for International Development. Ijeoma Mbajunwa West Africa Country Manager africa@tees.ac.uk Ijeoma joined Teesside University's West Africa Regional Office in 2019. She has provided administrative support for international students from across West Africa who intend to study at Teesside University, since 2014. In addition, she is responsible for organising the Teesside English Language Test for applicants from Africa. Shukurah Abolanle Assistant Manager, Admissions & Compliance S.Olajide@tees.ac.uk Shukurah Abolanle joined Teesside University West Africa Regional Office as Assistant Manager Admissions & Compliance in November 2021 where she is responsible for admissions and compliance issues within the region and provides support to international students on their application. Esther Sobola Student Recruitment and Conversion Officer e.olugbenga@tees.ac.uk Esther joined the West Africa Regional Office of Teesside University in September 2022 as a Student Recruitment and Conversion Officer. In her role, she is responsible for providing comprehensive support to international students throughout their admission journey, Esther's commitment to delivering exceptional service has helped numerous students transition smoothly into their academic pursuits at Teesside University. HOU Liang China Regional Director hou.liang@tees.ac.uk Liang joined Teesside University's International team in 2007 and leads the China office for the University. Liang originally came as an international student in 1999 from Shandong Province in China; he enjoys much of the local culture and made lots of friends locally. The North East of England became his new home. Liang stayed in this region for 12 years before moving back to Beijing to set up the China office. Having been a student himself, he understands international students and is always willing to help them. Benefitting from his own experience in the UK, he is eager to share it with the international students. WANG Mengsi Office Manager m.wang@tees.ac.uk Mengsi has been working for Teesside University China office since March 2012. She has worked in a variety of roles including admissions, marketing and recruitment in China. Her current role as Manager of the China office includes responsibility for Business School recruitment and managing the team. Mengsi enjoys traveling across China, interacting with students and providing the most up to date information about Teesside University. SUN Pingyao Recruitment Manager p.sun@tees.ac.uk Pingyao joined Teesside University China Office in April 2015 after graduating from the University of the West Scotland (BA) and Cardiff University (PG). Initially responsible for admissions, in September 2016 Pingyao started to work as Recruitment Officer for Creative programmes and managed the agent network, international foundation programmes, public universities, articulation programmes and individual applicants. Pingyao truly enjoys traveling all over China and expanding her knowledge when traveling with academics from different Schools. It is an exciting opportunity for her to share her knowledge and experience of our university with students and partners. FENG Xueer Admission Officer X.Feng@tees.ac.uk With over 6 years of experience in international education, Xueer joined Teesside University China Office in September 2024 as an Admissions Officer. She is responsible for admissions and enquiries from students and agents. Xueer is dedicated to enhancing the University's impact in China and helping students begin their journey at Teesside University. ZHOU Jiaqi Marketing Officer j.zhou@tees.ac.uk Jiaqi accomplished her master program in Southampton in 2014. Her previous working experience at a German education consulting company has brought her great interest in education and marketing. Jiaqi joined Teesside University as the Marketing Officer within the China Office in early 2017 and is responsible for marketing activities in China. She aims to enhance the branding of Teesside University in China. TANG Tianyu Tianyu.Tang@tees.ac.uk Tianyu has accomplished his master's programme in Indiana University of Pennsylvania in 2015 and joined Teesside University China Office in early 2019. He is responsible for the agent network and Health programmes. He enjoys local food during travel and like extreme sports. ZHAI Jiayue J.Zhai@tees.ac.uk Jiayue graduated from the University of Southampton with Marketing Management and joined in China office in July 2019. She is mainly responsible for Admissions and assists colleagues by responding to enquiries from student or agents as well. In her spare time, she enjoys travelling for enriching the knowledge and experiencing various cultures. GAO Ziyu Recruitment Officer Ziyu.Gao@tees.ac.uk Ziyu joined the China team in October 2024. He is responsible for the development of partnerships with institutions in China and increasing Teesside brand awareness. He is dedicated to improving student recruitment and fostering the Alumni network. Based in South China, he is passionate about supporting all our incoming students through the entire cycle, from application to orientation. His experience also includes work in the global tech industry and international education institutions. Reach out with questions about the Teesside Experience. Syed Abidi Regional Director - Pakistan S.Abidi@tees.ac.uk Syed Abidi is a renowned Educationist, Consultant and Trainer with over 25 years' experience in international education, marketing and recruitment. His responsibilities include expanding the current Pakistan market, overseeing the agent network, training and assuring outstanding support is delivered to students and partners of Teesside University. In addition, Syed identifies development opportunities within the Middle Eastern Region including but not limited to KSA, UAE, Oman, Iran and Bahrain. Syed Abidi is a recipient of a most prestigious Civil Award in Education from the President of Pakistan and has several international commendations and awards in the area of international student recruitment. Khalida Parveen Business development & operations officer k.parveen@tees.ac.uk Khalida has joined Teesside Regional Office Pakistan as Business Development and Operations Officer. She has more than 8 years of experience in international student recruitment and marketing with different reputable agencies. She will be assisting the Pakistan office in enhancing TU branding and profile and provide support in day to day operations. Zaeem Masood Regional Support Officer - Pakistan z.masood@tees.ac.uk Zaeem joined Teesside University in June 2021. He has 15 years of experience in student recruitment. He is responsible for admissions, marketing and recruitment activities in the Pakistan and Middle East/North Africa (MENA) region, including developing and maintaining working relationships with agencies. Padmini Parameswaran South Asia Regional Director padmini.parameswaran@tees.ac.uk Padmini joined Teesside University in the year 2016. She has 20 years of experience with Education UK. She started her professional career as a teacher and after working with some of the best schools across the country she joined Middlesex University's Regional Office as Manager of Admissions. She was Regional Director at University of Central Lancashire, University of East London and Northumbria University before she joined Teesside University. Padmini enjoys interacting with students and advising them on their career choices. She also likes to travel across South Asia and meet students from diverse backgrounds and cultures. Despite her experience, the role is a constant learning curve, even after several years of experience. Jayanti Pathare Conversions Manager J.Pathare@tees.ac.uk Jayanti joined Teesside University's South Asia office in December 2021 as an Assistant Manager and is currently working as the Conversions Manager; responsible for recruitment, conversions, and pre-departure activities among other things. She has almost a decade's worth of experience with Immigration New Zealand, having worked at their Auckland and Mumbai offices, where her last role was as a Technical Advisor. Iona Furtado Compliance Manager - South Asia i.furtado@tees.ac.uk Iona joined Teesside University as a Compliance Manager (South Asia) in 2021. She has 17 years of experience, a better part of which was as a Senior Immigration Officer at Immigration New Zealand. She also previously worked in operations at JP Morgan Chase. Padvala Nandan Naidu Compliance Manager - South Asia p.naidu@tees.ac.uk Nandan joined Teesside University as a Compliance Manager (South Asia) in 2021. His work involves conducting credibility interviews, verifying maintenance documents, overseeing enrollments and looking after compliance issues for South Asia applicants. He has over 10 years of experience in student recruitment for the universities in the UK and Ireland. He previously worked at Nexus Educational Services and IDP Education. He was awarded Top Counsellor for IDP - Pan India in 2019 and 2020 and has delivered more than 50 seminars about studying in the UK. June Chai South East Asia Regional Director, SEA regional office j.chai@tees.ac.uk June joined Teesside University South East Asia regional office in early 2019. Prior to Teesside University, she was also in recruitment of students for Malaysia, the UK and USA institutions for the past 15 years. Her current role includes developing and executing strategic business plans, positioning of Teesside University in SEA, building a strong network of local partners, recruitment of students with her team in the regional office; just to name a few. June enjoys the thrill in recruitment and the opportunities to meet with people from different walks of life. Her greatest satisfaction come from her students' success and building lifelong friendship along the way. June looks forward to grow, to learn and to succeed together with Teesside University in this region. Rachel Lee Operations Manager, SEA regional office rachel.lee@tees.ac.uk Rachel graduated from Lancaster University in 2019 with a MBA Master of Business Administration. She joined Teesside University's South East Asia regional office in 2007 when the office started its operations. She was previously was the Head of Operations and Finance for SEGi College in Penang, Malaysia. As an Operations Manager, Rachel manages the admission processes for South East Asia, and is also responsible for general operations, finance, office budgets and collaborations with transnational education (TNE) partners. Rachel plays a key role in organising and managing Teesside University's events in the South East Asia region. Ronnie Chai Regional Manager, ASEAN r.chai@tees.ac.uk Ronnie joined Teesside University as Assistant Regional Manager to support the execution of regional recruitment, marketing strategy, market research, marketing campaigns and marketing communications. He also supports the development and management of partnerships in conjunction with the international partnerships team and supports other initiatives aimed at raising the profile of Teesside University in these markets. Prior to working with Teesside University, Ronnie developed significant experience of assisting Southeast Asia students in the pursuit of higher education opportunities. In addition, he was also in student recruitment with a premier education group in Singapore. Ronnie enjoys the process of recruitment as much as the outcome and successes of his work. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Prior to joining the university, she worked at York St John University and University Bordeaux Montaigne (France). Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. Matthew Gallagher International Conversion Manager matthew.gallagher@tees.ac.uk Matthew joined the DID in May 2023 with over 10 years' experience working in the higher education sector. During his career, he has specialised in international recruitment and partnership development in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and the Americas. His experience also includes work on the UK government's Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office committee for international scholarships. In his current role, he develops integrated communication plans to guide students through the admissions and compliance process. In addition to this, his role also helps to advise students on how make an application, as well as advising students on pre-departure and orientation details. Matthew's portfolio also includes international scholarships and the extremely popular TU webinars for international students and partners. Lindsey Paylor-Orr International Marketing Officer l.paylor-orr@tees.ac.uk Lindsey joined Teesside University in 2015 following several years in marketing and communication roles at the University of the Arts, London. She is responsible for developing innovative digital and print marketing assets to support international development activities. Lindsey specialises in visual communication, focusing on widening audience participation through Accessibility best practices. Angela Faulkner Administration Coordinator a.faulkner@tees.ac.uk Angela has been with the university for over eleven years, the last six in International Development. Her previous roles involved working with students, businesses and stakeholders, skills she still continues to use in her current role. As Administrator she is responsible for monitoring the department budgets, arranging travel and supporting the Centre Manager with Erasmus+. Jade Davies International Marketing Assistant j.davies@tees.ac.uk Jade started her journey at Teesside University in June 2022, bringing a broad wealth of expertise in marketing and communications. Back during her pursuit of a bachelor's degree, a remarkable achievement came her way - the Dolphin Brewin Scholarship for International Business, beckoning her to Amsterdam for studies. This unique opportunity not only enriched her academic pursuits but also bestowed upon her a profound understanding of the global student adventure. In her capacity as an International Marketing Assistant, Jade plays a pivotal role, collaborating with the dynamic international marketing team to orchestrate and propel the University's endeavours in global marketing and communication. She has also achieved a Distinction in MSc Digital Marketing. Louise Kirby International Development Administrator l.kirby@tees.ac.uk With over 20 years' experience in Administration and PA roles across Teesside, Louise joined Teesside University in September 2013. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Prior to joining the university, she worked at York St John University and University Bordeaux Montaigne (France). Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. Matthew Gallagher International Conversion Manager matthew.gallagher@tees.ac.uk Matthew joined the DID in May 2023 with over 10 years' experience working in the higher education sector. During his career, he has specialised in international recruitment and partnership development in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA), Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia and the Americas. His experience also includes work on the UK government's Foreign, Commonwealth, and Development Office committee for international scholarships. In his current role, he develops integrated communication plans to guide students through the admissions and compliance process. In addition to this, his role also helps to advise students on how make an application, as well as advising students on pre-departure and orientation details. Matthew's portfolio also includes international scholarships and the extremely popular TU webinars for international students and partners. Lindsey specialises in visual communication, focusing on widening audience participation through Accessibility best practices. Angela Faulkner Administration Coordinator a.faulkner@tees.ac.uk Angela has been with the university for over eleven years, the last six in International Development. Her previous roles involved working with students, businesses and stakeholders, skills she still continues to use in her current role. Policy Home › International students › Meet the team Meet the team We are an international team with a mission to engage students, parents and partners in the pursuit of world-class education and life-changing experiences. The team create opportunities for international engagement, whether that is studying with us here at Teesside University, through TNE across the globe or by engaging in our extensive student mobility activities. Internationalisation is at the heart of Teesside University and we are proud to advance this agenda through our activity. Our people are our greatest asset; they’re smart, funny, clever, innovative and experienced. Feel free to contact us anytime or just read a little bit about us below. UK Africa China Pakistan South Asia South East Asia George Hunt Director of International Development george.hunt@tees.ac.uk George is Teesside's Director of International Development, with responsibility for overseeing international recruitment, student mobility initiatives and international partnerships. A graduate of University of Leeds and Northumbria University, George has worked in the UK HE sector for the past ten years and sees internationalisation is one of the most valuable elements of UK higher education. Originally from the Tyne Valley, he is a supporter of Middlesbrough FC but only for the glory. Jessica Watson James Deputy Director of International Development j.watsonjames@tees.ac.uk Jessica joined Teesside University in March 2022 with significant experience of recruiting and marketing to both UK and international students. Her career has been centred around higher education having worked in Swansea University and Cardiff University previously. Imran Rashid International Recruitment Manager - Middle East, North Africa and UK International I.Rashid@tees.ac.uk Imran joined Teesside University in March 2021 and has extensive experience in recruiting both UK and international students across his career. Imran worked in UK student recruitment for Teesside University and the University of Sunderland and then went on to work for QA Higher Education, where he recruited students from the Middle East and North Africa regions. Imran has a strong passion in assisting and providing opportunities for students in education around the world. Alizée Cordes International Student Mobility Manager A.Cordes@tees.ac.uk Alizée joined Teesside University in 2021 with experience in international student support, international mobility and recruitment. Alizée is passionate about international education and helping students achieve their full potential. She looks after international mobilities including summer experiences and study abroad. life-changing experiences.
